title: Burkina Faso calculator readiness research — Batch 41

findings.detail: INSD/DGESS EPA 2024/25 catalogue record BFA-MARAH-DGESS-EPA-2024-2025-v01, version 2.1, confirms crop-by-province production estimates, 5,304 households across 884 villages, 95% confidence and ±10% margin of error. Survey covers rainfed and off-season production, inputs, equipment, livestock and sales receipts.

The underlying microdata are restricted to approved named research-team members. The survey is representative for 43 provinces and excludes Soum and Loroum; it predates the July 2025 reform to 17 regions and 47 provinces.

Government's provisional 2025/26 campaign statement reports 7,142,484 tonnes of cereals, 1,246,132 tonnes of other food crops, 1,353,298 tonnes of cash crops excluding cotton, and 10,147,741 tonnes of dry-matter fodder. These are national aggregate totals, not regional crop yields.

SIMAgri exposes market-specific listings for cereals, cowpea, groundnut, soybean and other products, but the dynamic page does not expose reliable observation timestamps and transaction-level distinctions in the captured view. It is a lead for extraction, not a verified farm-gate series.

Government's June 2026 cotton campaign announcement sets cotton-specific fertiliser on-credit sale prices at CFA 17,500 per 50 kg bag. This is not a general fertiliser price for all farmers or crops and is not used as a general cost.

Government reported fall-armyworm infestation on 20,568 of 47,213 hectares prospected, with 17,724 hectares treated. Keep crop-protection risk and localised pressure visible; do not convert this into a national yield loss.

safeguards: No restricted microdata accessed or redistributed.
National aggregate crop totals are not converted into crop-specific or regional yields.
Historical 43-province survey data are not silently remapped to the current 47 provinces.
Dynamic market listings are not treated as dated farm-gate prices.
Cotton fertiliser support pricing is not generalized to other crops or farmers.
No Burkina Faso calculator values activated; existing active-country profiles unchanged.
